title: STILL HERE L: LIFT (V1)
description: L: LIFT. Two bars at 120 BPM (the factory on a B pedal, the spark growing), then five at 150 BPM in E, carried by a fixed 150 BPM engine project (2/4) whose ticks hold both tempos exactly. Ignition 4.000 s = frame 176,400 opens Emaj9.

tracks.description: The factory heartbeat on the B pedal (the kick asleep inside the MORPH press clank), once per second; a last beat at 11.6 s.
Electronic kick: a broken beat (1, the "a" of 2, 3-and) from ignition, four on the floor into the summit.
Clap on an electronic snare on 2 and 4; a 16th roll into the payoff.
Metallic hats in 16ths with an open hat on the last off-beat; shaker eighths from bar 4.
MORPH//04 cable ticks: the 3+3+2 precision rhythm, then the turbine ratchet.
Electronic crash at ignition and at the summit.
Analog-style bass one-shots, gated natively: syncopated roots, the rising A-B-C#-D# eighths into the payoff; ducked under the kick.
EXTERNAL: the soaring analog lead (two detuned saws and a pulse, legato glides, delayed vibrato, ensemble).
A warm triangle/sine bell-pluck: the spark growing in the factory (E4-F#4-B4, then E4-F#4-B4-C#5).
Warm polysynth: the Bsus4 swell into ignition, then Emaj9, F#/E, C#m9, Amaj9, the rising chords and Eadd9; ducked by the kick.
Pulse/saw pluck arpeggio in 16ths (3+3+2 waves) from ignition, dotted-eighth echo.
EXTERNAL: MORPH//03 Tempo String: the machine answers the spark (1.5 s), then the turbine winds into B1 and runs into ignition.
EXTERNAL: MORPH FDN room of lead, pad, arpeggio and bell, re-created at their exact frames.
